text: Tuma nde danndi on gaayi yimɓe mon ɓen, tertiɗon ko ɓe rewata kon gaanin Alla, on rewaali si wanaa Alla Kanko tun, fattoyagol ngol ka fammeere fii dogidugol e diina mon kan Joomi mon Seniiɗo On hiMo weftana=wertana on immorde e Yurmeende Makko nden ko hiMo reenira on ɗun immorde e ayɓe mon O hiwa on kadi, O niwinana on e fiyaake mon ko hiɗon nafitora ɗun, konko lontinanta on e ngurdanɗan hakkunde yimɓe mon.
